review.kind: literal linguistic review by assistant; no automatic grammar/coherence classifier claimed

review.not_permitted: letter insertions/deletions/substitutions, anagrams, revised key, lore-word scoring bonus
review.conclusion: No long grammatical continuous English reading independently compatible with Tibia lore was identified in these70fixed outputs.
review.scope: Rejects promotion of these literal outputs as candidate translations; does not exclude other decoding mechanisms.

near_match_warning.status: not a literal match and not a translation
